correction: V1 called the leave-one-family-out control no_cross_family even though it receives only the other families. No predictive metric, scoring seed, candidate or protected implementation existed. V2 changes only that causal-control name and its success statement; all tensors, families, masks, padding, normalization, loss, costs and forbidden behavior inherit unchanged from V1.

causal_candidates.shared: one source-identical learner and hyperparameter set slow-fitted on pooled training worlds from all three families
causal_candidates.independent: source-identical clones slow-fitted separately per evaluator-private family group; all clone fit/state/costs are summed
causal_candidates.cross_family_only: for each evaluated family, the same learner excludes all slow-fit worlds from that family, receives only the other two families, and adapts on identical public support
causal_candidates.support_only: same learner with no slow-fit worlds, adapted on identical public support

transfer_success_requires: shared beats independent on overall and minimum-family capability
cross_family_only beats support_only in every family
shared is not Pareto-dominated by independent, pooled probabilistic or native specialist controls
family router accuracy is reported but never itself counted as transfer
all acquisition, serialization, normalization, slow fit, support adaptation, query, update, bytes, state and R1/R4/R16 costs are charged
